> **TL;DR:** The Header is the top‑most bar of the site that shows the site title, primary navigation links, and optionally a search box or user avatar. It lives inside the `RootLayout` component, receives data from the page’s front‑matter (e.g., `title`), and uses the same `ToAnchor`/`AnchorProvider` utilities that the rest of the layout uses for smooth scrolling.

```tsx

```

That imported `Header` is then rendered inside the `RootLayout` component (see the snippet near the end of `app.tsx`):

```tsx
  </VerticalStack>
</RootLayout>
```

So the Header is **a child of `RootLayout`** and sits directly above the vertical stack that holds the sidebar and the main content.
